questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को
    कथन (A) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है और दूसरे को
    कारण (R) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है।
    कथन (A): परिवर्तनकारी नेता पुरस्कारों के लिए प्रदर्शन का
    आदान-प्रदान करके स्थिति को बनाए रखने पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं।
    कारण (R): परिवर्तनकारी नेतृत्व अनुयायियों को अपने स्वयं के स्वार्थों
    को संगठन के भले के लिए पार करने के लिए प्रेरित करता है।
options_hindi: दोनों A और R सत्य हैं और R A का सही स्पष्टीकरण है
दोनों A और R सत्य हैं लेकिन R A का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है
A सत्य है लेकिन R असत्य है
A असत्य है लेकिन R सत्य है
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Career Planning, Training, and Development

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Transformational leaders focus on maintaining the status quo by exchanging rewards for performance.
Reason (R): Transformational leadership inspires followers to transcend their own self-interests for the good of the organization.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Transformational leadership inspires followers to align with a shared vision and transcend personal self-interest for collective organizational growth, making the reason true. Transactional leadership, not transformational leadership, relies on maintaining the status quo through structured exchanges of rewards for compliance and performance. Therefore, the assertion falsely describes transformational leadership by attributing transactional characteristics to it.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। परिवर्तनकारी नेतृत्व अनुयायियों को साझा दृष्टि के साथ संरेखित करने और सामूहिक संगठनात्मक विकास के लिए व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ को पार करने के लिए प्रेरित करता है, जिससे कारण सत्य हो जाता है। लेन-देनात्मक नेतृत्व, न कि परिवर्तनकारी नेतृत्व, पुरस्कारों के संरचित आदान-प्रदान के माध्यम से स्थिति को बनाए रखने पर निर्भर करता है। इसलिए, कथन परिवर्तनकारी नेतृत्व का गलत वर्णन करता है क्योंकि यह इसे लेन-देनात्मक विशेषताओं को सौंपता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Transformational leadership inspires followers to align with a shared vision and transcend personal self-interest for collective organizational growth.

       अधीनस्थों के लिए बाधाओं को दूर करता है, जो अपेक्षा सिद्धांत पर भारी निर्भर करता है?
options_hindi: फीडलर का आकस्मिकता मॉडल

महान व्यक्ति सिद्धांत

questions.question_english:
Which of the following leadership models
       explicitly focuses on the leader’s role in clarifying
       the paths to goals and removing obstacles for
       subordinates, drawing heavily on expectancy
       theory?
options_english: Fiedler’s Contingency Model
Trait Theory
Great Man Theory
Path-Goal Theory
questions.explanation_english:
Developed by Robert House, Path-Goal Theory
       asserts that a leader’s primary role is to assist
       subordinates in achieving organizational goals
       by clarifying expectations, providing necessary
       support, and removing environmental obstacles
       along the path to goal attainment. Rooted in
       expectancy theory, it suggests that employee
       motivation increases when effort directly leads
       to valued rewards and successful performance
       outcomes.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। पथ-लक्ष्य सिद्धांत, रॉबर्ट हाउस द्वारा विकसित, यह बताता है कि नेता की प्राथमिक भूमिका अधीनस्थों को संगठनात्मक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने में सहायता करना है, अपेक्षाओं को स्पष्ट करना, आवश्यक समर्थन प्रदान करना और लक्ष्य प्राप्ति के रास्ते में पर्यावरणीय बाधाओं को दूर करना। यह अपेक्षा सिद्धांत पर आधारित है, जो यह सुझाव देता है कि जब प्रयास सीधे मूल्यवान पुरस्कारों और सफल प्रदर्शन परिणामों की ओर ले जाता है, तो कर्मचारी प्रेरणा बढ़ती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Path-Goal Theory
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Path-Goal Theory asserts that a leader’s primary role is to assist subordinates in achieving organizational goals.

जलवायु केवल छात्र व्यवहार द्वारा निर्धारित होती है, जबकि संस्कृति प्रिंसिपल द्वारा निर्धारित होती है।
कोई वैचारिक भेद नहीं है; दोनों शब्द प्रशासन में एक दूसरे के स्थान पर उपयोग किए जाते हैं।

questions.question_english: The term 'School Climate' is often differentiated from 'School Culture.' Which of the following statements most accurately captures this distinction?
options_english: Climate refers to deep underlying historical values, whereas culture refers to infrastructure.
Climate is determined strictly by student behavior, whereas culture is set by the Principal.
There is no conceptual distinction; both terms are used interchangeably in administration.
Climate is the immediate atmosphere; culture involves deep historical norms.
questions.explanation_english: Organizational climate refers to the immediate, observable administrative atmosphere, perceptions, and daily interpersonal feelings within a school environment, which can shift relatively quickly. Conversely, organizational culture represents the deeply ingrained historical values, underlying beliefs, shared traditions, and long-standing norms that govern behavior over extended periods across the institution.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। संगठनात्मक जलवायु तत्काल, प्रेक्षणीय प्रशासनिक वातावरण, धारणाएँ, और स्कूल के वातावरण में दैनिक अंतरव्यक्तिगत भावनाओं को संदर्भित करती है, जो अपेक्षाकृत जल्दी बदल सकती हैं। इसके विपरीत, संगठनात्मक संस्कृति गहरे निहित ऐतिहासिक मूल्यों, अंतर्निहित विश्वासों, साझा परंपराओं, और लंबे समय तक व्यवहार को नियंत्रित करने वाले मानदंडों का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Climate is the immediate atmosphere;

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Organizational climate refers to the immediate, observable administrative atmosphere, perceptions, and daily interpersonal feelings within a school environment, which can shift relatively quickly.

questions.question_english: The newly appointed Vice-Principal feels overwhelmed by the administrative workload and struggles with the procurement process. The Principal decides to pair the Vice-Principal with an experienced senior administrator for weekly one-on-one sessions over six months to build confidence and navigate administrative hurdles. This scenario exemplifies what?
options_english: Sensitivity Training
Off-the-job simulation
Mentoring

questions.explanation_english: Mentoring is an individualized, supportive developmental relationship where an experienced senior administrator guides a junior colleague through regular personal interactions over an extended period. Pairing a Vice-Principal with a senior administrator provides ongoing psychosocial encouragement, practical guidance on procurement rules, and administrative problem-solving insights, exemplifying workplace mentoring in educational management.

       and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009,
       what percentage of the members of a School
       Management Committee (SMC) must consist of
       parents or guardians of students admitted in the
       school?
questions.explanation_english:

       to Free and Compulsory Education Act

questions.question_english: In standard communication models, 'Feedback' is crucial because it:
options_english: substantially increases semantic noise within the communication channel.
slows down administrative decision-making processes unnecessarily.
eliminates the necessity for maintaining written documentation.
confirms that the receiver accurately understood the message.
questions.explanation_english: Feedback is an essential component of the communication process because it completes the communication loop. It provides the sender with information regarding how the message was decoded, interpreted, and understood by the receiver. Effective feedback verifies message accuracy, clarifies misunderstandings, reduces semantic distortion, and allows adjustments to ensure administrative communication achieves its intended purpose.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। फीडबैक संचार प्रक्रिया का एक आवश्यक घटक है क्योंकि यह संचार चक्र को पूरा करता है। यह प्रेषक को यह जानकारी प्रदान करता है कि संदेश को प्राप्तकर्ता द्वारा कैसे डिकोड, व्याख्या और समझा गया। प्रभावी फीडबैक संदेश की सटीकता की पुष्टि करता है, गलतफहमियों को स्पष्ट करता है, अर्थ संबंधी विकृति को कम करता है, और यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए समायोजन की अनुमति देता है कि प्रशासनिक संचार अपने इच्छित उद्देश्य को प्राप्त करे।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Confirms that the receiver accurately understood the message.
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Feedback is an essential component of the communication process because it completes the communication loop.

Donald Kirkpatrick’s Four-Level Model is
     globally recognized for evaluating training
     effectiveness. What does Level 3 of this model
     measure?
options_english: Reaction (How participants felt about the training)
Behavior (Application of learning and change in practice on the job)

questions.explanation_english: Donald Kirkpatrick’s Four-Level Training Evaluation Model assesses training across four distinct stages: Reaction, Learning, Behavior, and Results. questions.question_english: In the context of behavioral theories of leadership, the Ohio State University studies identified two major dimensions of leader behavior. What are they?
options_english: Employee-oriented and Production-oriented
Concern for people and Concern for production
Task behavior and Relationship behavior
Initiating structure and Consideration
questions.explanation_english: The leadership studies conducted at Ohio State University identified two independent dimensions of leader behavior: Initiating Structure and Consideration. questions.question_english: In Frederick Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory of motivation, which of the following is classified as a 'Motivator' (satisfier) instead of a 'Hygiene factor' (dissatisfier)?
options_english: Institutional administrative policies
Recognition for high performance
Physical working conditions in class
Interpersonal relations with leadership
questions.explanation_english: In Frederick Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory, workplace factors are categorized as Motivators or Hygiene factors. Motivators are intrinsic factors that yield job satisfaction, including personal growth, responsibility, achievement, and recognition for high performance. Conversely, working conditions, administrative policies, and interpersonal relations represent Hygiene factors, which prevent job dissatisfaction but do not inherently motivate higher performance.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। फ्रेडरिक हर्ज़बर्ग के दो-कारक सिद्धांत में, प्रेरक तत्व वे अंतर्निहित कारक हैं जो नौकरी की संतोषजनकता उत्पन्न करते हैं, जैसे व्यक्तिगत विकास, जिम्मेदारी, उपलब्धि, और उच्च प्रदर्शन के लिए मान्यता। इसके विपरीत, कार्य स्थितियाँ, प्रशासनिक नीतियाँ, और अंतरव्यक्तिगत संबंध स्वच्छता कारक हैं, जो असंतोष को रोकते हैं लेकिन उच्च प्रदर्शन को प्रेरित नहीं करते।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Recognition for high performance
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Motivators are intrinsic factors that yield job satisfaction.

questions.question_english: Which of the following best defines the primary distinction between educational administration and educational management in the context of school governance?
options_english: Administration focuses on policy formulation and goal setting, whereas management handles operational execution.
Administration focuses on operational execution of tasks, whereas management formulates long-term policies.
Administration focuses on financial resource allocation, whereas management handles pedagogical leadership.
Administration focuses on transformational leadership, whereas management relies on situational frameworks.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that administration focuses on policy formulation and goal setting, whereas management handles operational execution. Educational administration operates at a broad structural level, dealing with high-level policy formulation, establishing organizational goals, and defining overall governance frameworks. Conversely, educational management functions on an operational basis, focusing on executing these established policies, managing daily physical and human resources, directing teaching staff, and ensuring smooth routine implementation to achieve specific institutional objectives successfully.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रशासन नीति निर्माण और लक्ष्य निर्धारण पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है, जबकि प्रबंधन संचालनात्मक कार्यान्वयन को संभालता है। शैक्षिक प्रशासन व्यापक संरचनात्मक स्तर पर कार्य करता है, उच्च-स्तरीय नीति निर्माण, संगठनात्मक लक्ष्यों की स्थापना, और समग्र शासन ढांचे को परिभाषित करने से संबंधित होता है। इसके विपरीत, शैक्षिक प्रबंधन संचालनात्मक आधार पर कार्य करता है, स्थापित नीतियों को लागू करने, दैनिक भौतिक और मानव संसाधनों का प्रबंधन करने, शिक्षण स्टाफ का निर्देशन करने, और विशिष्ट संस्थागत उद्देश्यों को सफलतापूर्वक प्राप्त करने के लिए सुचारू दिनचर्या कार्यान्वयन सुनिश्चित करने पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Administration focuses on policy formulation

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Educational administration operates at a broad structural level, dealing with high-level policy formulation, establishing organizational goals, and defining overall governance frameworks.

questions.question_english:
In the assessment of staff development programs,
      when does 'Formative Evaluation' take place?
options_english: Long after program completion to track long-term career progression.
At final completion of the program to assign terminal performance grades.
Prior to participant selection and baseline assessment procedures.
During program design and delivery to make ongoing improvements.
questions.explanation_english: Formative evaluation occurs continuously during the design, development, and implementation phases of a staff development program. Its primary objective is to monitor ongoing progress, gather real-time feedback, identify instructional difficulties, and make immediate adjustments to training content or methodologies before final completion, ensuring the program achieves its intended learning objectives.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। आकारात्मक मूल्यांकन कर्मचारी विकास कार्यक्रम के डिज़ाइन, विकास और कार्यान्वयन के चरणों के दौरान निरंतर होता है। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य ongoing प्रगति की निगरानी करना, वास्तविक समय की प्रतिक्रिया एकत्र करना, शैक्षणिक कठिनाइयों की पहचान करना और अंतिम पूर्णता से पहले प्रशिक्षण सामग्री या विधियों में तात्कालिक समायोजन करना है, जिससे कार्यक्रम अपने निर्धारित शिक्षण उद्देश्यों को प्राप्त कर सके।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) During program design and delivery to make ongoing improvements.

questions.question_english:
The Johari Window is a conceptual model primarily used for:
       enhancing self-awareness and interpersonal communication in groups.
options_english: Allocating financial and administrative budgets across school departments.
Evaluating physical structural integrity of classroom windows and doors.
Improving self-awareness and interpersonal communication in groups.
Measuring cognitive intelligence metrics and academic potential of pupils.
questions.explanation_english: The Johari Window is a cognitive heuristic model designed by Joseph Luft and Harry Ingham to enhance self-awareness and interpersonal communication within groups. It categorizes information regarding feelings, behaviors, and motives into four quadrants based on whether details are known or unknown to self and others, facilitating personal feedback and group trust.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। जोहरी विंडो एक वैचारिक मॉडल है जिसे जोसेफ लुफ्ट और हैरी इन्गम द्वारा विकसित किया गया था। यह आत्म-जागरूकता और अंतर-व्यक्तिगत संचार में सुधार के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। यह चार क्वाड्रेंट में जानकारी को वर्गीकृत करता है, जिससे व्यक्तिगत फीडबैक और समूह विश्वास को बढ़ावा मिलता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Improving self-awareness and interpersonal communication in groups.

questions.question_english: During the induction training of a newly recruited government school teacher, which of the following topics is least likely to be a primary focus?
options_english: Service conditions, leave rules, and conduct rules.
Overview of applicable school education acts and the RTE Act 2009.
Familiarization with the organizational structure of the Department of Education.
Advanced Ph.D. level research methodology in educational philosophy.
questions.explanation_english: Induction training for newly recruited government school teachers focuses on practical job orientation, including service rules, leave policies, departmental administrative structures, and statutory frameworks like the RTE Act 2009.
